# Harbour City — Sketchfab asset list

*Generated from `Assets/CarSales/HarbourCity/harbour-city-assets.json` — do not edit by hand; edit the manifest and re-run `tools/manifest_docs.py`.*

Every model below was found and verified through the public Sketchfab Data API v3 (downloadable,
licence checked, face count recorded). **Files are not committed to this repository** (the full set is
about 3.5 GB). Fetch them with:

```
SKETCHFAB_TOKEN=<your token> python3 tools/download_sketchfab_assets.py
```

(Token: sketchfab.com → Settings → Password & API. The files land in `Assets/CarSales/Sketchfab/`.)

Then verify every download **before** opening Unity:

```
python3 tools/preflight_assets.py     # writes docs/ASSET_PREFLIGHT.md
```

and see docs/ASSET_MAP.md for which model lands on which map site. After that, run **Tools → Car Sales → Harbour City → Build Harbour City** in Unity.

**80 assets kept** · licences: by ×72, cc0 ×8

Car model names use real makes, consistent with the game's existing real-car stance (acknowledged in the
Release Checklist); dealership buildings with real-brand signage were excluded instead (see exclusions).
Entries flagged **needs review** should be eyeballed in the Asset Studio before shipping.

## Notes

- Hand-reviewed by name and size on 2026-11-09 after curation; excluded entries are listed under 'exclusions' with the reason.
- All kept entries are CC0 or CC-BY (search filter), free for commercial use with attribution (BY) - see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
- GLB files are NOT committed to this repository (several GB total). Run tools/download_sketchfab_assets.py with SKETCHFAB_TOKEN to fetch them into Assets/CarSales/Sketchfab/.
- Brand names in car model titles follow the game's existing real-car stance (acknowledged in the Release Checklist); dealership buildings with real-brand signage were excluded instead.
- Entries flagged needsReview should be eyeballed in the Asset Studio (load, check scale/materials) before shipping.
